floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.

frontier.hypothesis: Flip Region A sum/j $a0 tie by lifting sum's local-alloc priority (or dropping j's) with a structural change, no dead code.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc qty priority tiebreak assigns $a0 to counter j over accumulator sum.
frontier.next_probe: read .lreg qty priority for pseudo 77(sum)/79(j); try hoisting `s32 chk = *(s32*)((u8*)chkptr+0x6C);` before the inner loop (changes sum's post-loop consumer to a local compare) and other init/consumer relocations; sandbox each.

frontier.hypothesis: Make Region B LICM constants schedule before the ap/a2p moves structurally (no constant-holder cheat).
frontier.mechanism: preheader LUID/priority ordering in sched1 after LICM hoist.
frontier.next_probe: restructure the range-check spelling or defer the ap/a2p init (e.g. derive a2p from ap inside the loop) so moves' LUID rises above the hoisted constants, or the constants are not hoisted into the same preheader block; sandbox each.

frontier.hypothesis: Directed permuter seeded from the floor-8 form sweeps both ties/schedules.
frontier.mechanism: PERM_* over statement order in the two regions + range-check form explores the alloc/schedule cross-product the manual levers can't fully enumerate.
frontier.next_probe: build clean single-fn target.o (asm/funcs + prelude), seed base from candidate.c, run campaign with fresh-seed stopping rule; vet any closing form against the cheat catalog (dead-store/constant-holder are the known trap).
